articles.title: Securitize stock jumps over 10% after launching tokenized US equities on Solana
articles.description: Securitize’s new offering gives eligible investors access to tokenized shares of 12 US companies, with dividend and voting rights and plans for round-the-clock trading.

articles.title: NFL backs New Jersey authorities in SCOTUS petition over Kalshi
articles.description: According to the league, Kalshi and other prediction markets “threaten game integrity” because many event contracts are “highly susceptible to manipulation.”

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Netflix drops trailer for series based on FTX’s SBF and Caroline Ellison
articles.description: Sam Bankman-Fried remains in federal prison following his 2023 conviction, while Caroline Ellison was released in January.

articles.title: IMF warns tokenized markets could amplify financial risks
articles.description: The global financial institution found tokenized equity markets less liquid and more volatile than traditional markets, despite growing demand for 24/7 trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears 3-week low as oil heads higher on Iran strike woes
articles.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 and oil prices gained after reports that military confrontation between the US and Iran could return.

articles.title: US government moves $1B in seized Bitcoin after $770M transfers
articles.description: Blockchain analysts identified the US government wallet tied to the recovery of funds from the Bitfinex hack.

articles.title: ‘No going back’ for institutions moving toward tokenized onchain future, says Fidelity
articles.description: Tokenization offers structural advantages to financial institutions and helps asset managers reach new markets, according to Fidelity’s head of digital asset strategists.

articles.title: Crypto lending rises again… but have they solved the risks?
articles.description: Crypto lending has risen by 55% since July, but now has to deal with the dangers of AI assisted hacks, and risks cascading through interlinked protocols. Here’s how to stay safe.

articles.title: EU lawmakers push crypto onto anti-corruption agenda
articles.description: MEPs also called for stronger asset recovery, while the Commission plans to adopt its first anti-corruption strategy by the end of this year.

articles.title: Sui’s Hashi to launch with $500M in Bitcoin finance commitments
articles.description: Hashi has more than $500M in commitments ahead of mainnet launch, while Anchorage offers institutions settlement and self-custody.

articles.title: US government moves $770M of seized Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime
articles.description: The US government moved 9,261 Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime, including 2,456 BTC in newly discovered funds pointing to federal law enforcement seizures.

articles.title: Bitcoin monthly ‘new money’ inflows near $5B as BTC price rally stalls
articles.description: Bitcoin’s realized cap rise in the 30 days to Oct. 5 came mostly from existing holders, not fresh capital, Glassnode data showed.

articles.title: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins
articles.description: ESMA said EU crypto firms should halt services involving non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins, giving regulators three months to address existing exposures.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
articles.description: Eligible US Galaxy will be able to send USDC to crypto wallets and transfer funds to bank accounts in more than 60 countries.

articles.title: NEAR enters crypto’s top 20 after 140% surge in 30 days
articles.description: NEAR climbed into the top 20 cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, as NEAR Intents surpassed $31 billion in cumulative transaction volume.

articles.title: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore
articles.description: Standard Chartered plans custody for cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and tokenized assets for institutional and eligible corporate clients in Singapore.

articles.title: Greece plans 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrencies
articles.description: Greece’s draft bill proposes a 10% tax on crypto capital gains, with exemptions for annual gains of up to 500 euros and crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: US Bitcoin ETFs shed $485M in biggest daily outflow since June
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs erased October’s net inflows with $485 million in withdrawals, while Ether funds logged a seventh straight outflow session.

articles.title: Crypto’s heavy backing of Republicans alienated Democrats: Cuomo
articles.description: Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo urged the crypto industry to balance its support for Democrats and Republicans if they want federal crypto legislation passed.

articles.title: Crypto must cement adoption to withstand US policy shifts: Canton CEO
articles.description: Canton CEO Yuval Rooz compared blockchain adoption to Uber and Airbnb, arguing that widespread adoption could help insulate it from potential policy reversals.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin backs crypto ‘bunker mode’ amid rapid AI math advances
articles.description: Ethereum researchers say crypto users should consider an orderly migration of funds to fresh addresses, warning AI could threaten private-key security before quantum computers do.

articles.title: Circle brings USDC, EURC payments to SAP customers through Tereina
articles.description: The partnership with SAP-backed Tereina will let businesses send and receive Circle’s stablecoins from within the financial software they already use.

articles.title: Hunter Biden confirms LAPTOP token ‘not a rug pull,’ just trolling Trumps
articles.description: “Trump’s coin was max extraction, and I wanted to troll every grift like it,“ said Hunter Biden in a breakdown of the memecoin launch and fallout.

articles.title: Sui tunnels hit 40.6M TPS in live AI agent test
articles.description: The layer-1 blockchain said its programmable offchain tunnels reached the milestone during a live stress test designed to simulate high-frequency activity between AI agents.

articles.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
articles.description: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

articles.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
articles.description: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient.

articles.title: Coinbase brings global crypto derivatives liquidity to US with Deribit integration
articles.description: US institutions will gain access to Deribit’s options and perpetual futures through Coinbase, with US retail options expected later this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $82.7K October low as bond sell-off resumes on Iran nerves
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to reach month-to-date lows as stocks reversed after all-time highs and bond yields spiked higher.

articles.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
articles.description: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.
